name: garnerbin
description: Country grain elevator receiving, grading, shrink and settlement

scripts.blend: node bin/garnerbin.js blend -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv --base S-4474 --base-bushels 100000 --add S-4476 --add-bushels 20000 --target 2
scripts.book: node bin/garnerbin.js book -c examples/rush-creek.json -t examples/tickets-2025-10-09.csv -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv -b 4.2750
scripts.doctor: node bin/garnerbin.js doctor -c examples/rush-creek.json -t examples/tickets-2025-10-09.csv -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv --contracts examples/contracts-2025.json --board examples/board-2025-10-09.csv --basis examples/basis-2025-10-09.csv
scripts.exceptions: node bin/garnerbin.js exceptions -c examples/rush-creek.json -a 2025-10-20 -t examples/tickets-2025-10-09.csv -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv
scripts.register: node bin/garnerbin.js register -c examples/rush-creek.json -t examples/tickets-2025-10-09.csv -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv -b 4.2750
scripts.settle: node bin/garnerbin.js settle -c examples/rush-creek.json -t examples/tickets-2025-10-09.csv -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv --board examples/board-2025-10-09.csv --basis examples/basis-2025-10-09.csv --period 2025-10
scripts.validate: node bin/garnerbin.js validate -c examples/rush-creek.json -t examples/tickets-2025-10-09.csv -s examples/samples-2025-10-09.csv --strict
